name: Hansol Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Hansol Chemical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells various chemicals primarily in South Korea. The company offers a range of fine chemicals, including hydrogen peroxide, sodium hydrosulfite, benzoyl peroxide, HITEX SB latex, HANBL NB latex, HanSphere, flocculant, organic coagulant, retention agent, and fixing agents, as well as semiconductors comprising high-k, silicon, and electrode and metal precursors. It also provides display materials, such as quantum dots, a self-luminous nanoparticle; UV ink, a low-viscosity ink-jet resin; and functional UV resin.
